profile.cardDescription: Update your name, password, and avatar.
profile.currentPasswordRequired: Enter your current password to set a new one.
profile.timezoneHelp: Used for due dates, daily reminders, and recurring task math. Detected from your browser when you registered; change it here if it's wrong.
profile.avatarUploadHelp: Any image. It is cropped square and resized for you.

avatar.failed: That picture could not be saved.

security.devicesDescription: Mobile devices that are currently logged in to your account. Revoking access will log the device out.
security.noDevicesHint: When you log in from a mobile device, it will appear here.
security.revokeDialogDescription: This will log out <bold>{{deviceName}}</bold>. They will need to log in again to access your account.
security.newKeyDescription: Copy this key now. You will not be able to view it again.
security.generateDescription: Create long-lived credentials for scripts or integrations.
security.expirationHelp: Leave blank for a key that never expires.
security.readOnlyHelp: The key can read data but never create, change, or delete anything. Recommended for automation and integrations.

guildAI.title: Community AI
guildAI.adminOnly: Only community admins can manage AI connections. To set your own key, open AI in your profile settings.
guildAI.connectionsDescription: Define the AI connections members of this community can use.
guildAI.disabledDescription: AI features are turned off for the platform.
guildAI.managedByPlatform: AI connections are managed at the platform level. Members set their own key in their profile settings.

platformAI.title: Platform AI
platformAI.description: Choose how AI is configured across the platform. Like sign-in, AI is managed either by the platform or by each community — never both.
platformAI.adminOnly: Only platform owners can manage platform AI settings.
platformAI.mode_disabled_description: AI features are turned off for everyone.
platformAI.mode_platform_description: You define the AI connections every community uses.
platformAI.mode_guild_description: Each community admin defines their own AI connections.
platformAI.connectionsDescription: Define the AI connections every community uses.

interface.title: Interface settings
interface.colorThemeDescription: Choose a color theme for the application.
interface.weekStartsOnDescription: Choose which day to show first on calendars and date pickers.
interface.recentTabsLimitDescription: How many recently-opened items to keep in the header tab bar (1–100).
interface.languageDescription: Choose your preferred language for the interface.

taskCompletionVisualFeedback.label: Task completion feedback
taskCompletionVisualFeedback.description: A bit of fun when you finish a task you were assigned to.

taskCompletionAudioFeedback.label: Sound on task completion

taskCompletionHapticFeedback.label: Vibration on task completion
taskCompletionHapticFeedback.description: Briefly vibrate your device when you finish any task. Mobile / supported browsers only.

keepScreenAwake.label: Keep screen awake
keepScreenAwake.description: Prevent this device's screen from dimming or locking while the app is open. This setting is saved on this device only.
keepScreenAwake.unsupported: Your browser does not support keeping the screen awake.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.description: Control which notifications you receive by channel. Bell notifications always appear regardless of these settings.
notifications.pushDescription: Receive real-time alerts on your device
notifications.pushBlockedDescription: To enable push notifications, open your device settings, find this app, and enable notifications.
notifications.overdueTimeHelp: Daily reminder time (uses the timezone above).

categories.initiativeInvitesDescription: When you’re added to a new initiative.
categories.taskAssignmentsDescription: Hourly summary when others assign you tasks.
categories.mentionsDescription: When someone mentions you or comments on your work.
categories.commentReactionsDescription: A periodic summary when people react to your comments.
categories.newProjectDescription: When projects are created in your initiatives.
categories.overdueTasksDescription: Daily reminder for tasks past due at your scheduled time.
categories.eventsDescription: When you’re invited to an event, or one you’re attending changes.
categories.eventRemindersDescription: A reminder before events you’re attending begin.

reminderLeadTime.label: Remind me
reminderLeadTime.atStart: At the time of the event

dangerZone.disconnectDescription: Log out and disconnect from this server. You can connect to a different server afterward.
dangerZone.title: Danger Zone
dangerZone.subtitle: Irreversible and destructive actions for your account.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account or deactivate it temporarily. This action affects your projects, documents, and other content.
dangerZone.deactivateDescription: Temporarily disable your account. Your name, email, and content remain intact, but you'll be removed from every community you're a member of — rejoining requires a fresh invite. An administrator can reactivate your account later.
dangerZone.permanentDeleteDescription: Completely remove your account from the system. Projects will be transferred to other users. Comments and documents will remain but show "[Deleted User]". <bold>This cannot be undone.</bold>
dangerZone.permanentDeleteDescriptionText: Completely remove your account from the system. Projects will be transferred to other users. Comments and documents will remain but show "[Deleted User]".

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.eligibilityError: Unable to check account deletion eligibility.
deleteAccount.softDeleteDescription: Your account will be deactivated. You won't be able to log in, but your data will be preserved. An administrator can reactivate your account.
deleteAccount.hardDeleteDescription: Your account will be permanently deleted. Your projects must be transferred to other members. Comments will show "[Deleted User]".
deleteAccount.blockersDescription: The following issues must be resolved before you can delete your account:
deleteAccount.lastAdminGuilds: You are the last admin in these communities. You must promote another member or leave before deleting.
deleteAccount.transferDescription: You own the following projects. Choose a new owner for each:
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: This action is irreversible. Enter your password and type DELETE MY ACCOUNT to confirm.
deleteAccount.chooseTypeDescription: Choose how you want to delete your account
deleteAccount.checkBlockersDescription: Checking if your account can be deleted
deleteAccount.checkBlockersDeactivateDescription: Checking if your account can be deactivated
deleteAccount.deactivateLabel: Deactivate my account (admins can activate it for you later)
deleteAccount.deactivateRadioDescription: You will not be able to log in, and you'll be removed from every community you're in — rejoining requires a fresh invite. A platform admin can reactivate your account on request. Your name, email, and content remain intact.
deleteAccount.softDeleteLabel: Delete my account (remove my personal information)
deleteAccount.softDeleteRadioDescription: Your name, email, and avatar will be removed and you will not be able to log in. Comments, tasks, and other content you authored will remain visible as "Deleted user". This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.resolveIssues: Please resolve these issues before deleting your account.
deleteAccount.resolveIssuesDeactivate: Please resolve these issues before deactivating your account.
deleteAccount.eligible: Your account is eligible for deletion.
deleteAccount.eligibleDeactivate: Your account is eligible for deactivation.
deleteAccount.selectNewOwners: Select new owners for your projects before proceeding with account deletion.
deleteAccount.selectNewOwnersDeactivate: Select new owners for your projects before proceeding with account deactivation.
deleteAccount.deactivateConfirmDescription: Your account will be deactivated. You will not be able to log in until an administrator reactivates your account. You will be removed from every community you belong to, and rejoining will require a fresh invite. Your name, email, and content remain intact.
deleteAccount.softDeleteConfirmDescription: Your name, email, and avatar will be removed. You will not be able to log in. Comments, tasks, and other content you authored will remain visible as "Deleted user". This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.agreeConsequences: I understand this action cannot be undone

branding.adminOnly: Only platform admins can manage branding settings.
branding.colorsDescription: Customize the accent colors for light and dark mode.
branding.lightModeHelp: Buttons, highlights, and focus states use this color while the app is in light mode.
branding.darkModeHelp: Accent and primary elements use this color while dark mode is active.

chesterPlayground.title: Chester toast playground
chesterPlayground.description: Trigger each toast type to preview its Chester variant and animation.

withDescription.label: with description
withDescription.detail: Your changes are now live across all devices.

email.adminOnly: Only platform admins can manage email settings.
email.title: SMTP email
email.description: Configure the SMTP server used for transactional emails.
email.secureHelp: Enable for port 465. Keep disabled for ports 587 or 25 (uses STARTTLS when available).
email.rejectUnauthorizedHelp: Disable only if you fully trust the mail server and understand the risk.
email.passwordHelp: Leave blank to keep the existing password.

auth.adminOnly: Only platform admins can manage authentication settings.
auth.title: OIDC authentication
auth.description: Configure single sign-on for your workspace.
auth.enabledHelp: Allow users to authenticate via your OIDC provider.
auth.clientSecretHelp: Leave blank to keep the existing secret.
auth.mappingsDescription: Map claim values from your identity provider to community and initiative memberships.
auth.claimPathCardDescription: Dot-notation path to the claim array in the OIDC token. Common paths:
auth.claimPathHelp: The dot-separated path to the claim in the ID token. Leave blank if not needed.
auth.rulesDescription: Map OIDC claim values to community and initiative memberships.
auth.noMappings: No mappings configured. Add a mapping to automatically assign users to communities and initiatives when they sign in via OIDC.
auth.mappingDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this mapping?

platformUsers.title: Platform users
platformUsers.description: Manage all users across the platform.
platformUsers.promoteDescription: This will give {{email}} platform admin permissions, allowing them to manage platform settings, users, and configurations.
platformUsers.demoteDescription: This will remove platform admin permissions from {{email}}. They will no longer be able to access platform settings.
platformUsers.resetDescription: This will send a password reset email to {{email}}.
platformUsers.cannotDemoteLastAdmin: Cannot demote the last platform admin
platformUsers.permissionRequired: You don't have permission to view platform users.

roleDescriptions.member: Standard access to their own communities. No platform-wide privileges.
roleDescriptions.support: Read-only platform visibility (users, communities, audit) and can request time-bound access to a community.
roleDescriptions.moderator: Everything Support can do, plus user management (suspend/reactivate) and content moderation.
roleDescriptions.operator: Manages users, communities, and roles platform-wide, with cross-community data access and approves access requests.
roleDescriptions.owner: Full control, including app-wide configuration (auth, branding, email, AI). The only role that can manage configuration.

platformUsers.changeRoleDescription: This will change {{email}}'s platform role to {{role}}.
platformUsers.changeUsernameBody: They will be told, and they cannot change it back themselves. The number stays as it is.
platformUsers.suspendBody: They keep everything — memberships, sharing, and everything they have written — and reach no community until this is lifted. They can still sign in to their own account, where they will see your reason.
platformUsers.actionError: That could not be done. Try again.

adminDeleteUser.title: Delete User
adminDeleteUser.subtitle: Delete {{email}}
adminDeleteUser.deactivateDescription: User cannot log in. PII preserved. Reversible from the users page.
adminDeleteUser.softDeleteDescription: PII removed. User cannot log in. Content authorship is preserved as "Deleted user". Cannot be reversed.
adminDeleteUser.hardDeleteDescription: All user data is removed from the database. Comments, tasks, and other content authored by this user are deleted via cascade. Cannot be reversed.
adminDeleteUser.blockersDescription: The following issues must be resolved before this user can be deleted:
adminDeleteUser.initiativeBlockerDescription: Promote another member to project manager:
adminDeleteUser.deleteGuildConfirm: Delete community "{{guildName}}"? This will permanently delete all community data.
adminDeleteUser.deleteInitiativeConfirm: Delete initiative "{{initiativeName}}"? It and all its projects, tasks, documents, queues, and events will be sent to the trash. You can restore the whole tree from Settings → Trash before the retention period ends.
adminDeleteUser.transferDescription: This user owns the following projects. Choose a new owner for each:
adminDeleteUser.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{email}} — they cannot log in but their data is preserved.
adminDeleteUser.confirmSoftDelete: Anonymize {{email}} — PII is removed. Comments and tasks they authored remain visible as "Deleted user". This cannot be reversed.
adminDeleteUser.confirmHardDelete: Permanently delete {{email}} — the row and all cascading data are removed. This cannot be reversed.

accessGrants.title: Access requests
accessGrants.description: Request and approve time-bound access to a community you're not a member of.
accessGrants.requestDescription: Ask for temporary, scoped access to a community. Approvers grant it and it auto-expires.

breakGlass.title: Break glass
breakGlass.description: Self-issue emergency access to a community — approved instantly, scoped to that community, and auto-expiring. Read & write acts as a full community admin. Every break-glass grant is recorded.
breakGlass.reasonPlaceholder: Why you need emergency access (e.g. incident #123)

accessGrants.queueDescription: Grant, deny, or revoke time-bound access requests.

platformLayout.title: Platform settings
platformLayout.subtitle: Configure authentication, branding, email, the community directory, AI, community storage, and app services for the entire platform.

appServices.adminOnly: Only platform owners can manage app services.
appServices.title: App services
appServices.description: The containers that run this deployment's apps. A registration is the only place an app's address, shared secret, and powers are recorded.
appServices.empty: No app services are registered yet. Start an app's container, then add it here using the same shared secret.

statusHelp.ok: The last handshake succeeded and the manifest still matches the one on record.
statusHelp.unverified: No handshake has completed yet. That is expected until the container answers.
statusHelp.unreachable: The address did not answer with a manifest. Check that the container is running and reachable.
statusHelp.manifest_mismatch: The app describes itself differently from the record. Verify it to review the change.
statusHelp.signature_mismatch: The app answered with a different shared secret. Check that both sides hold the same one.

appServices.disabledHelp: This app is stopped for every community that installed it. Nothing has been deleted.
appServices.mandatoryHelp: Installed into every community automatically. Community admins cannot remove it or turn it off.
appServices.delegationHelp: This app may call the API as a real member, under that member's own permissions.
appServices.delegationJwksHelp: The public half of the key this app signs delegation tokens with. Paste the key set the app publishes; two entries mean a rotation is in flight. Clearing the box removes it.
appServices.appDirectoryHelp: This app may ask where another app installed in the same community answers. Needs delegation as well: an automation service holds both, because acting on one app's behalf at another is what it is for.
appServices.createDescription: Point Initiative at a running app container. Both sides must hold the same shared secret.
appServices.editDescription: Changing the address or the shared secret clears the recorded verification, so verify the app again afterwards.
appServices.publicIdHelp: Optional. A reachable app names itself. Supply it to register before the container is running.
appServices.publicIdHelpEdit: The identifier cannot be changed once the registration exists.
appServices.baseUrlHelp: Where Initiative's server calls the app. This may be a private address inside your own network.
appServices.embedOriginHelp: Where a member's browser loads this app's embedded surfaces and connection pages. Leave blank when the app answers at the base URL for both.
appServices.allowedOriginsHelp: One per line. Leave blank to allow only the browser address's own origin.
appServices.allowedOriginsHelpEdit: One per line. Leave blank to keep the current origins.
appServices.secretHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
appServices.secretStored: A shared secret is stored for this app.
appServices.secretMissing: No shared secret is stored, so this app cannot be verified until you set one.
appServices.grantsHelp: Only you can grant these. An app can never claim one for itself.
appServices.saveError: Could not save the app service.
appServices.deleteError: Could not delete the app service.
appServices.verifyError: Could not verify the app service.
appServices.toggleError: Could not change the app service.
appServices.disableDescription: Every community that installed this app stops reaching it immediately — data, configuration, events, and embedded pages all refuse. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it back on at any time.
appServices.deleteDescription: The registration and its stored shared secret are removed for good. Every community that installed this app stops reaching it, and adding it back means entering the secret again.
appServices.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the app identifier to confirm
appServices.manifestChangedDescription: This app's manifest no longer matches the one recorded when it was registered, so its features, connections, or embedded pages may have changed. Accepting adopts the new manifest and marks the app verified. Only accept it if you expected this app to change.

guilds.title: Community limits
guilds.description: Set per-community caps on storage and on the number of users. Lowering a limit below current usage blocks new uploads or members, but never removes existing files or members.
guilds.adminOnly: You need the platform owner role to manage community limits.
guilds.loadError: Could not load communities. Please try again.
guilds.helpText: Storage limits are in GB; user limits are a member count. Both save automatically — leave a field blank for unlimited.
guilds.overLimitHint: {{name}} has more members than its current limit allows.
guilds.saveError: Could not update the storage limit. Please try again.
guilds.usersSaveError: Could not update the user limit. Please try again.
guilds.statusSaveError: Could not update the community status. Please try again.
guilds.guildAuthOff: Disabled per-community sign-in for {{name}}. Existing members keep signing in; no new accounts onboard.

suspendConfirm.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspendConfirm.description: Members lose all access and the community disappears from their list. Nothing is deleted and you can reactivate it anytime; operators keep access via a break-glass grant.

billing.openError: Could not open the billing portal.

adminDashboard.title: Admin dashboard
adminDashboard.subtitle: Manage platform users and time-bound access grants.

storage.adminOnly: Only platform owners can configure storage.
storage.title: Object storage
storage.description: Choose where uploaded files (documents, attachments) are stored. Defaults to the local filesystem; switch to an S3-compatible store for scalable or shared deployments.
storage.backendHelp: Local stores files on the server disk. S3 works with AWS S3, a self-hosted Garage/MinIO instance, Cloudflare R2, and similar.
storage.cutoverTitle: Switching to S3 doesn't move existing files
storage.cutoverHelp: Save these settings, run Test connection, then use Backfill below to copy existing local files into the bucket. Switch the backend to S3 only once the backfill completes — optionally keep "Serve missing objects from local" on during a verification window.
storage.endpointHelp: Leave blank for AWS S3. Set this for Garage, MinIO, R2, or any non-AWS store.
storage.accessKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the ambient credential chain
storage.secretKeyHelp: Leave blank to keep the stored key. Stored encrypted; never displayed.
storage.pathStyleHelp: Required for Garage and most non-AWS stores.
storage.localFallbackHelp: During cutover, read blobs not yet copied to S3 from the local disk.
storage.backfillHelp: Copies every existing local upload into the configured bucket. Idempotent and safe to re-run; run it before switching the backend to S3.

registry.title: Identity providers
registry.description: The single sign-on providers this community's members sign in with. Configured by this community's admins and applying only here.
registry.dialogDescription: OpenID Connect provider details. The callback URL for your IdP is /api/v1/auth/g/{{guildId}}/{slug}/callback on this server.

shareUrl.title: Member sign-in link
shareUrl.description: Share this link with members — it offers this community's sign-in providers and brings them straight into the community.

policy.title: Sign-in requirement
policy.description: Control which sign-in a session must have used before it can access this community.
policy.openHelp: Any signed-in member can access this community.
policy.requiredHelp: Members can only access this community after signing in with the selected provider.
policy.noProviders: No providers are configured yet. Add one under Identity providers below, then require it here.
policy.error: Could not save the sign-in requirement
policy.selfUnsatisfied: Your current session hasn't signed in with {{providerName}} yet. Sign in with it once to confirm it works before requiring it.

authProviders.title: Additional sign-in providers
authProviders.description: Offer more ways to sign in alongside the platform single sign-on above. Each provider gets its own button on the sign-in page.
authProviders.reservedHelp: Managed in the single sign-on settings above
authProviders.dialogDescription: OpenID Connect provider details. The callback URL for your IdP is /api/v1/auth/{slug}/callback on this server.
authProviders.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes. Fixed after creation — it forms the sign-in URLs.
authProviders.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes; no leading or trailing dash.
authProviders.tenantHelp: Replace {tenant} with your Entra tenant ID.
authProviders.secretPlaceholder: Leave blank for a public (PKCE-only) client
authProviders.secretKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
authProviders.allowJitHelp: When off, only existing accounts can sign in with this provider.
authProviders.deleteDescription: Accounts keep their other sign-in methods, but links to this provider are removed permanently.

aiConnections.title: Connections
aiConnections.subtitle: Each connection is a destination — a provider, model, and optional shared key.
aiConnections.empty: No connections yet. Add one to enable AI features.
aiConnections.deleteDescription: "{{label}}" will be removed. Members using it will lose access.
aiConnections.platformDialogDescription: Every community can use this connection.
aiConnections.guildDialogDescription: Members of this community can use this connection.
aiConnections.apiKeyHelpExisting: Leave blank to keep the existing key.
aiConnections.apiKeyHelpNew: The shared key all members use for this connection.
aiConnections.enabledDescription: Allow members to use this connection.
aiConnections.defaultDescription: Members use this connection unless they pick another.
aiConnections.allowMemberKeysLabel: Let members use their own API key
aiConnections.allowMemberKeysDescription: Members can attach a personal API key to this connection.

memberAI.title: My AI
memberAI.description: See every AI connection available to you across your communities. Add your own API key where allowed and pick the one you use.
memberAI.noneAvailable: No AI connections are available to you yet.
memberAI.managedByAdmin: Managed by your admin — uses a shared key.

community.title: Community directory
community.description: Let communities list themselves where anyone signed in can find them and join without an invite.
community.helpText: While this is on, an admin can list their community from its settings, and “Join a community” appears beside everyone's own. While it is off, there is nothing to browse and nothing can list itself.
community.reversibleNote: Turning this off hides the directory; it does not un-list the communities that opted in. Turn it back on and the same communities are listed again.
community.saveError: Could not change the community directory. Please try again.
community.adminOnly: You need the platform owner role to run a community directory.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: What was done to accounts, by whom, and when. Entries are kept after the accounts they name are gone.
